Expand Explicit TaskNet Inventory Relationships

Source: R/tasknet.R
onet_tasknet_relations.Rd

Converts declared refinements and overlaps into unique TaskNet-to-comparison edges. Reciprocal declarations are counted once. No matching, transitive closure, weighting, or exposure estimation is performed.

Usage

onet_tasknet_relations(tasks)

Arguments

tasks

The unmodified tibble returned by onet_tasknet_read().

Value

A tibble with from_study_task_id, to_study_task_id, relation_type ("refines" or "overlaps"), onet_soc_code, from_inventory, to_inventory, and the reader's provenance columns. The from endpoint is always TaskNet. Refinement means that this statement refines the comparison statement at to. Empty inputs and relation-free inventories have the same typed output schema. Distinct relationship types on the same pair are retained as separate edges, so edge counts need not equal counts of distinct statement pairs.

Details

Build relationships before filtering or editing the reader output. A content signature rejects modified data rather than presenting derived declarations as relationships from the original source bytes. This is an integrity guard, not a security or authenticity signature.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "tasknet-synthetic.csv", package = "onet2r")
onet_tasknet_relations(onet_tasknet_read(path))
#> # A tibble: 5 × 13
#>   from_study_task_id to_study_task_id relation_type onet_soc_code from_inventory
#>   <chr>              <chr>            <chr>         <chr>         <chr>         
#> 1 S-FIX-01           O-FIX-01         refines       15-1252.00    TaskNet       
#> 2 S-FIX-02           O-FIX-01         refines       15-1252.00    TaskNet       
#> 3 S-FIX-02           O-FIX-02         refines       15-1252.00    TaskNet       
#> 4 S-FIX-03           O-FIX-02         overlaps      15-1252.00    TaskNet       
#> 5 S-AUX-01           O-AUX-01         overlaps      31-1122.00    TaskNet       
#> # ℹ 8 more variables: to_inventory <chr>, from_source_record <int>,
#> #   to_source_record <int>, source_path <chr>, source_url <chr>,
#> #   source_sha256 <chr>, source_read_at <chr>, source_as_of <chr>
